Regarding the sentiment analysis of the provided Japanese text:

The text expresses a highly **positive** sentiment. The user describes the game as "surprisingly addictive" (驚くべき程度に中毒性があります), praises the graphics as "wonderful" (素晴らしく), and the storyline as "engaging" (魅力的). Although the phrase "spent a lot of time" (多くの時間を費やしてしまいました) can sometimes imply regret, in this context, combined with the preceding positive descriptors, it indicates deep engagement and enjoyment rather than dissatisfaction.
